use: Measure hydrodynamic size and polydispersity (PDI) of nanoparticles / micelles.
simulation: Intensity-weighted Z-average and PDI from the size distribution of nanoparticles in the sample.
notes: Dynamic light scattering particle sizer: Malvern Zetasizer class (173° backscatter). Specs not verified.
sources: DLS principle: intensity-weighted Z-average size and cumulants PDI (ISO 22412)
to_calibrate: Check with standard latex beads (e.g. 60 nm polystyrene)

measure.description: Measure the Z-average size (nm) and polydispersity index PDI of particles in the cuvette on the instrument (~2 min)
